description:
Purpose: Delete saved monitors and everything they collected; a deletion cannot be undone.
When: Only when the user asks to delete them.
Cost: Under 30 tokens for the reply.

monitorIds.description: Ids of the monitors to delete, 1 to 10, from monitor_list.

name: monitor_delete

deleted.description: The ids of the deleted monitors.

failed.description: Ids that could not be deleted just now; present only when some could not.

notFound.description: Ids that name no monitor of the user; present only when some do.

title: Delete job monitors
